english: Five numerical specialists couple causal spatial response, climate, watershed surplus constraints and economics to three-stage agronomic control. Raw AlphaEarth features remain private, and the external WOFOST81-SNOMIN referee only audits executed actions. The frozen three-seed 36-D MLP has 13,155 parameters per seed; causal anomaly adaptation augments Static3 and falls back to it under OOD.

P1 farm-year nitrogen regimes, objective retention and price stress. a Six EUNEP input-output facets with KDE and52 farm-years per policy; DVS uses Full-Telemetry, all other facets Sensorless. The white target satisfies NUE0.50–0.90 and surplus0–40. b Eight-policy boxplots and jittered farm-year points; NUE display clips0.2–2.2, with archived equal-region mean11.56 and pooled median disclosed. c Region-equal objective-retention waterfall, Dev AU rescue and52-case paired tie strips; Holm p=1.00 does not establish superiority or equivalence. d Filled1x to open2x price arrows, marker area scaled with executed N; bare2x is not evaluated. Climate and economic settings are simulator interventions.

P2 transfer preserves distinct cohort, scheme and admission denominators. a Five-adapter LOYO filled rose/LORO open blue dumbbells for Former n40, with Public-Reused NL n4 blue diamonds; paired admission bubbles show predictive rows, world-equal prediction and pooled closed-loop decisions. b Separate LOYO and LORO regional curves and descriptive gain bands. c LOYO Former40 EUNEP phase space for Full64, Static3 and ExtraTrees64. d Frozen paired compliance-effect intervals with Holm p1.00 and four separate world/row Grain-N MSE comparisons. Retain negative LORO ExtraTrees contrast and predictive degradation; no prospective blind-test claim.

The complete180-cell stress surface retains90 canonical black outlines. a-c Joint compliance by climate; d-f Soft-minus-PPO differences. Columns are price1x subsidy0, price2x subsidy0 and price1x subsidy50, each with caps25,35,40,50. g Cap-dependent mean differences and45-cell-per-cap win/tie/loss counts. h Full five-region effects and all five leave-one-region-out sensitivities at five headline regimes. i Partial profit and published native N loss across actual subsidy levels; x marks no-economics at50 only. Shaded envelopes describe climate ranges. Idealized warming is not an operational forecast.

Execution evidence and soil diagnostics bound claims. a Selected N supply components (executed fertilizer and native soil-stock drawdown) versus selected fate components (grain N and published native N loss), with apparent versus stock-adjusted NUE. Components omit straw, roots and other boundary transfers and therefore are not a closed grain-only mass budget. Native results are SHA-verified, seeds averaged within farm-year and regions weighted equally. b Log daily residual gauges against N1e-10/C1e-9 tolerances over6104146 configuration-days;1886 native plus16382 exact replays, zero violations. c All50 TRAIN readouts, including6 negatives; black frame encloses30 required positive cells. d All50 latent/raw parity points with target and track legends. TRAIN associations are not causal identification; neural auxiliary training skipped.
chinese: 五个数值专职模块耦合因果空间响应、气候、流域氮盈余约束和经济政策，服务三阶段农艺控制；原始卫星向量保持私有，外部物理裁判只核算已执行动作。
P1展示同信息约束下的目标保持、区域异质性与土壤氮透支权衡；缺失的策略和信息组合不补值，历史参照不宣称胜过PPO。
P2分开原留出与荷兰公开复用、LOYO与LORO；先验接受率不等于预测改善，保留LORO预测误差劣势。
180格完整压力面保留不利单元，90格连续性单元用黑框标出；下排展示真实补贴曲线，理想化气候扰动不等于业务预报。
执行计数、配置逐日守恒及TRAIN物理解码共同限定结论；重复配置日不代表独立轨迹，解码相关不等于因果机制。
